references.text: The first census in Israel was also commanded by the Lord to Moses, showing a pattern of divine instruction to count the people.
Eleazar is mentioned as Aaron's son, and his role as priest is established after the death of Nadab and Abihu.
Eleazar succeeded his father Aaron as high priest, which explains why he now stands beside Moses in this command.
Eleazar's lineage as Aaron's son and his position as priest are documented here.
The context just before this census, where Phinehas, Eleazar's son, stopped the plague, shows why a new count was necessary after many had died.
